The plate looks like a square plate about 22 cm across, so I treated it as a side-to-dinner size.

**Egg whites (scrambled):** The pile covers roughly 10 x 9 cm and is about 2.5 cm high, which comes to around 120 g. A loose, fluffy pile is less dense than that volume suggests, so I settled on 110 g. Scrambled egg whites run about 110 kcal per 100 g.

**Sausage (chorizo-style pieces):** There are 6 pieces, each about 3 cm long and 2 cm across, at roughly 12 g each. That gives about 70 g. Chorizo is about 400 kcal per 100 g.
